meta_description: Compare Anime Vanguards crafting, synthesis, and dismantling recipes by materials, Gold cost, output, and action type.
intro_md: The Crafting station in the Upgrades area turns essences and other materials into evolution items, potions, or different resources. Crafting builds upward, dismantling breaks essences down, and synthesis helps redirect spare Legend Stage drops.
description_md:
## Crafting essences and evolution items

Crafting consumes the listed materials plus its Gold cost to make the shown result. Colored essences build from Green Essence, while Rainbow Essence combines the colored types and then feeds several evolution-item recipes.

Check every input before spending. Similar recipes often change only one color or quantity, which is a small difference right until the station eats the materials you meant to save.

## How synthesis works

Synthesis applies to eligible evolution items from Legend Stages. You sacrifice two copies of another eligible item to receive one chosen eligible result, making duplicate drops useful when the stage refuses to cooperate.

New items from a major update do not enter synthesis immediately. They are added in the following half update, so a fresh evolution material may need to be farmed normally before it becomes selectable.

## When to dismantle essences

Dismantling converts colored essences back into Green Essence for a Gold fee. It is useful when you have the wrong colors for the next recipe, but the return is lower than the original crafting path.

Dismantle only the surplus you are ready to lose. Keeping a reserve of colored and Rainbow Essence avoids paying to rebuild the same material chain later, a loop with all the charm of buying your own groceries twice.

faq_json.q: Where is the Crafting station in Anime Vanguards?
faq_json.a: It is in the Upgrades area. Crafting, synthesis, and dismantling are handled there.

faq_json.q: What can I make with crafting?
faq_json.a: Recipes include colored and Rainbow Essence, evolution items, and utility items such as Super Lucky Potion.

faq_json.q: How does Legend Stage synthesis work?
faq_json.a: Sacrifice two copies of another eligible Legend Stage evolution item to receive one chosen eligible item.

faq_json.q: Why is a new evolution item missing from synthesis?
faq_json.a: Items introduced in a major update are added to synthesis in the following half update, so the newest material may not be eligible yet.

faq_json.q: Should I dismantle every spare essence?
faq_json.a: Usually not. Keep colors needed by planned evolution recipes, then dismantle only the surplus you want to turn back into Green Essence.
